title: A history of orchid care
description: Keep the phase observed, photographs and actions for every specimen, allowing for the differences between species.

blocks.text: The owner saves their own name for the orchid, photographs and the phase they observe. They can compare the current state with the past and recall the dates of their own actions, even if the variety is missing from the reference book.

quote.text: Overall, the app is great! I use it as my orchid journal. However, it lacks the intelligence to accurately identify my orchids, and the database for manual searches is quite limited in terms of orchid species.

blocks.text: A diary of one particular orchid

A first version is worth building around convenient records and comparing one specimen over time. The suggested name can be corrected, and a change in the reference information does not erase the personal diary.
First the journal, then the special advice

The review confirms the value of a journal like that and the shortcomings of the catalog, but not the need for a separate program for all orchids. Special recommendations make sense only after the differences between the species the audience needs have been checked, not as the same advice in a new wrapper.
